major_cooldowns.name: Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Send it right after your opening Thrash, then fill the window with Thrash, Mangle and as many Maul or Raze casts as your rage allows without capping.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 102558 is the cast and self aura id seen in 3 of 5 sampled parses; 394786 shares the name and was not observed, so it is the talent node.

major_cooldowns.name: Berserk
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cram Thrash and Mangle into its 15 seconds and dump the rage they build into Maul or Raze.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Berserk and Incarnation: Guardian of Ursoc share a talent slot; 2 of 5 sampled parses cast Berserk, 3 cast Incarnation.

major_cooldowns.name: Red Moon
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it on cooldown, and work it into the opener once your first Thrash is bleeding.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1252871 is the cast and enemy aura id in all 5 sampled parses; 1253582 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Lunar Beam
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Drop it on cooldown, and open with it right after your first Mangle.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 204066 is the cast id in all 5 sampled parses; 1270292 is the enemy aura and 204069/414613 were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Convoke the Spirits
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it in Bear Form on cooldown so its four seconds fire off your bear abilities for free.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Cast in 2 of 5 sampled parses; the rotation guide does not cover it, so the usage note comes from the tooltip.

major_cooldowns.name: Heart of the Wild
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it in Cat Form for the free Feral Frenzy, or out of form for a group Wild Growth when the raid is hurting.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1261867 is castable per its tooltip but no casts appeared in the sampled parses; Feral Frenzy (274838) debuffs in all 5 confirm the Cat Form use the guide describes.

rule.description: Keep Moonfire up on your primary target
rule.action: Reapply Moonfire as soon as the dot expires, and spend Galactic Guardian procs on it.
Press Thrash on cooldown so the bleed never drops and stays stacked.

rule.description: Maul only at 80 rage or above
rule.action: Hold Maul until you are at 80 rage so Harnessed Rage doubles its Gore chance.

rule.description: Open Thrash into Mangle into Lunar Beam
rule.action: Get Thrash bleeding first, then Mangle, then drop Lunar Beam.
